# llms.txt - Logismos AI navigation index

> An agent-aware operating environment for local AI compute, targeting AMD gfx1100.
> Rust, HIP and owned WMMA kernels. Public on GitHub: forkwright/logismos.

## LLM corpus

Structured reference data for AI agents is in `_llm/`:

- [_llm/glossary.md](_llm/glossary.md): Domain term definitions (GDN, WMMA, wave32, TurboQuant, ModernBERT, ...)

## Core docs

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Operating instructions, boundaries, standards
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Cross-tool bootstrap guide
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview and layout
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): Crate topology and dependency model
- [contracts/runtime-scope.toml](contracts/runtime-scope.toml): declared load/quantize/infer/serve boundary and structural guardrails
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history

## Planning

The operator-managed private planning corpus is canonical for Logismos's vision, roadmap, state,
research dossiers, and phase plans. It deliberately has no public repository path or link. Ask the
operator or approved planning service for the active material. [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)
records implemented crate ownership; Kanon standards govern engineering practice.

- Active private planning material - governs future scope and sequencing
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) - implemented crate topology and dependency model

## Key crates

- `crates/core/` - current stable public model trait (`EmbeddingModel`)
- `crates/isa/` - pure configured target-ISA token and feature-suffix parser
- `crates/hipcore/` - HIP FFI surface, device/stream/memory
- `crates/placement/` - deterministic action-free resource plans and process-local reservation accounting
- `crates/sched/` - bounded CPU-only admission/residency coordination
- `crates/emulation/` - bounded original CPU functional instruction witnesses
- `crates/kernels/` - HIP + CPU reference kernels
- `crates/transformers/` - transformer building blocks (attention, norms)
- `crates/encoders/` - encoder model impls (Stella, ModernBERT)
- `crates/embed/` - embedding pipeline
- `crates/rerank/` - `Reranker` trait and cross-encoder implementations (GteReranker, ModernBERT CPU)
- `crates/quant/` - original CPU block/row reconstruction for admitted quantized formats
- `crates/loader/` - safetensors, bounded GGUF v3 observation, and digest-bound immutable payload ownership
- `crates/decoders/` - Qwen3.5-family structural preflight and explicit bounded native CPU hybrid execution
- `crates/decode/` - checked CPU logit processing and token selection
- `crates/bin/` - CPU-only `plan` and typed GGUF `inspect` commands
- `crates/tokenize/` - tokenizer facade
- `crates/logismos/` - top-level integration facade

## Research

- `research/` - preflight docs for hardware-gated features
